Maya Ortiz: Solaria POC reporting intermittent SSE parse errors: browser logs show 'Unexpected end of JSON input' when stream ends.
Devon Park: can you attach the raw SSE output they captured?
Maya Ortiz: they sent this (redacted):
`data: {"id":"m1","delta":{"content":"Row1"}}

data: {"id":"m1","delta":{"content":"Row2"}}`
Maya Ortiz: last event truncated in their capture.
Ravi Menon: proxy logs for session s-77 show ALB idle timeout at 60s, but runtime also shows model process exit (OOM) at same window. Likely abrupt close from backend.
DeployBot: [deploy] routed s-77 -> node-9 at 2026-09-06T09:14:05Z
Ivy Chen: enable stream-debug header and short tracing; add proxy watchdog to emit an `event: error` before close if possible.
Ravi Menon: patched runtime to restrict huge priming on that tier and filed RW-STREAM-621.
Maya Ortiz: told customer to curl from a home network and send HAR; sales offered a 2-week Dedicated eval credit to rule out noisy-neighbor OOMs.
Customer (via Maya): will test and confirm tomorrow.
Devon Park: follow-ups: short-lived trace, watchdog shim, confirm keepalive through CDNs.
Maya Ortiz: thanks all, will update when customer responds. :thumbsup:
